: 30°48′58″N 97°19′59″W ﻿ / ﻿ 30.81611°N 97.33306°W ﻿ / 30.81611; -97.33306 From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Ghost town in Texas, United States Donahoe, Texas Ghost town Donahoe Show map of Texas Donahoe Show map of the United States Coordinates: 30°48′58″N 97°19′59″W ﻿ / ﻿ 30.81611°N 97.33306°W ﻿ / 30.81611; -97.33306 Country United States State Texas County Bell Elevation 538 ft (164 m) Time zone UTC-6 ( Central (CST) ) • Summer ( DST ) UTC-5 (CDT) Area code 254 GNIS feature ID 1379673 [ 1 ] Donahoe is a ghost town in Bell County , in the U.S. state of Texas . [ 1 ] It is located within the Killeen-Temple-Fort Hood metropolitan area . Geography [ edit ] Donahoe was located on Donahoe Creek, 16 mi (26 km) southeast of Belton in the southeastern corner of Bell County. [ 2 ] Education [ edit ] Today, Donahoe is located within the Bartlett Independent School District .
